source_art: 85 individually generated assets; modular variants assembled from the new art

integration.terrain_detail_underlay: Interior tiles contain genuine alpha cracks. Put existing terrain backing behind them; edge and corner overlays mask the front artwork only.
integration.tile_repeat: Repeat on the listed axis at step_px. Do not auto-trim sprites.
integration.static_magic: Runes, rings, trails and particles are independent static overlays.
integration.scale: Assets are authored in pixel space; place at 1× before applying a common world scale.

assets.description: One wide dense foreground bush bank, dark emerald leaves with restrained olive edge highlights, uneven leafy silhouette, small open gaps between stems. Entire standalone vegetation cluster, no terrain or scene. Rich darker palette appropriate in front of gameplay.

One wide hanging canopy LEAF CLUSTER overlay with thin curved branch across top and downward dangling large dark green leaves. Entire branch and all leaf tips visible with margins. No trunk, sky or scenery.
One isolated wide dark blue-green forest foliage silhouette cluster, layered fern and pointed leaf shapes, very subtle two-tone cel shading, crisp readable outer silhouette, no scenery or ground.

One isolated foreground outcrop silhouette, dark desaturated teal slate rocks, asymmetric wide low shape, two restrained shadow tones and faint edge accents. No moss forest backdrop, no ground layer. Entire rocks visible.
